0.original: Lulutsu wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Gladiators' Guild.

1.original: Lulutsu has bid you speak with First Sword Mylla, whose approval you must obtain if you wish to join the guild.

2.original: Satisfied that you have the strength to live by the sword, the guildmaster furnishes you with a weathered weapon. Equip the blade and speak to her once more to begin your training.

48.original: What will it be? Will you rise above the masses and inscribe your name in legend, or will you resign yourself to mediocrity and die in obscurity?

49.original: Oh, so it's to be death in obscurity...

50.original: Well, should you come to your senses, you may speak with me at any time to proceed with the enrollment process.

51.original: A decision you shan't regret. One moment─make way for <hex:022903EB0203>! Fresh meat coming through!

52.original: Now then, before your enrollment can be considered complete, you must present yourself to First Sword Mylla. Seek her out and obtain her approval.

53.original: Aye, I heard Lulutsu. So you're <hex:022903EB0203>. 'Tis a good, strong name.

54.original: On behalf of the Gladiators' Guild, allow me to welcome you. I am Mylla, guildmaster here.

55.original: So you wish to study our arts. I presume you have your reasons for choosing the sword over all other weapons. Perhaps you think it easiest to learn.

58.original: A sword is a simple weapon. But to wield a blade well is anything but simple.

59.original: For every Coliseum champion to emerge from our ranks, there have been countless disappointments who failed to achieve greatness.

60.original: Bear that in mind before you answer me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, for I do not ask this question lightly: have you the strength to live by the sword and─if it be your fate─die by it?

62.original: Have you the strength to live by the sword?

65.original: Then perhaps your path lies elsewhere. Should it lead you back to us someday, we can discuss your future once more.

67.original: Then welcome, gladiator, to your new home!

68.original: Take this sword. There are many like it, but this one is yours now.

69.original: Consider it a gift if you like. Now wear it on your hip as I do, and show me you are ready to begin your training!

71.original: You have unlocked a new class! You can change to this class at any time by equipping the weapon received from this quest.

72.original: When changing classes, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>gear sets<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will allow you to register and save your equipment. You may then use them to switch between classes instantly without the need to manually equip weapons or equipment.

73.original: A button for the Gear Set interface is located in the upper portion of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Character<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> window.
